verdict.rationale: Perplexity documents an official `pplx` CLI. It returns structured JSON from the Search API and is explicitly aimed at shell pipelines, interactive terminal work and coding agents, which squarely fits an AI-native CLI workflow. A probe confirms the CLI overview page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, and documentation of CLI coverage beyond search and page-snippet extraction (e.g., Agent API or Computer tasks, install and auth details).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The pplx CLI returns structured JSON from the Perplexity Search API, making it useful for shell pipelines, interactive terminal work, and coding agents that need current web results or query-relevant page snippets.
Extract the passages of a page that are relevant to a query, instead of retrieving the whole page
